The old pin was the CODATA-2018 vintage of the muon anchor; the shift is 8.0 \times 10^{-11} relative. The per-braid ceiling \hbar_q^4/(1-\hbar_q^2) = 97.3 ppm is unchanged at its stated precision.

⚠ The E_0 and \mathfrak{Q}_\beta rows are NOT refreshed, deliberately. They are producer outputs of the q_\beta channel, whose values depend on the trace convention as well as on q_0 — and that channel's C→D migration is tracked separately as qou-cds1, where the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta figures move by \sim 0.05 MeV. Refreshing a pin underneath a convention that is itself about to change would produce numbers nobody has checked. Those rows must be regenerated from the producer under D, in one pass, not substituted here.

So this table currently mixes a refreshed \hbar_q against unrefreshed E_0 and \mathfrak{Q}_\beta. That is the state the per-block rule warns about, and it is accepted here only because the remaining rows need a convention decision rather than an arithmetic one — recorded so it is not mistaken for completion.
